description: List Mandate operations: ready document packages an agent can order: es_auction_poa (Spanish power of attorney to bid on the BOE Portal de Subastas), de_gmbh_formation (German GmbH/UG Musterprotokoll package), it_srls_formation (Italian SRL semplificata on the official video model), fr_eurl_formation (French single-member SARL on the statutory model articles) and apostille_translation (EU27: apostille or exemption, competent authority, e-Apostille, sworn translation). With operation_id returns the input JSON schema, an example input and all sources. Free during beta.

country.description: Optional ISO country code (ES, DE, IT, FR) or EU for the cross-border apostille_translation.

operation_id.description: Optional: return one operation with input_schema and example_input.

name: list_operations
